serverview.title: Server changes
serverview.badgeTitle: Read-only view of the working copy on {name}
serverview.hint: Commit on the server, or bring the changes here
serverview.readOnly: Read-only view of the server's working copy.
serverview.clean: No uncommitted changes on the server.
serverview.files: {n, plural, one {# changed file} other {# changed files}}
serverview.notGit: The folder on the server is not a git repository
serverview.missing: The folder does not exist on the server
serverview.readFailed: Git could not read the working copy
serverview.none: No runs on a server yet. Pick a server and a repository to look at its working copy.
serverview.add.label: Show a repository of a server
serverview.bringTip: Apply the server's uncommitted changes to this working tree
serverview.sendTip: Apply your uncommitted changes to the server's working copy
serverview.diff.title: {name} on {server}
serverview.dlg.bringIntro: The uncommitted changes of {repo} on {server} are applied to your working tree. Nothing is committed, staged, pushed or checked out.
serverview.dlg.sendIntro: Your uncommitted changes in {repo} are applied to the working copy on {server}. Nothing is committed, staged, pushed or checked out.
serverview.dlg.counts: {tracked, plural, one {# changed file} other {# changed files}}, {untracked, plural, one {# new file} other {# new files}}
serverview.dlg.onTop: Apply on top of the uncommitted changes already there
serverview.dlg.onTopBring: Your working tree has uncommitted changes. The patch is applied only if it fits them; otherwise nothing changes.
serverview.dlg.onTopSend: The working copy on the server has uncommitted changes. The patch is applied only if it fits them; otherwise nothing changes.
serverview.dlg.dirtyBring: Your working tree has uncommitted changes. Tick "apply on top" to continue, or commit or stash them first.
serverview.dlg.dirtySend: The working copy on the server has uncommitted changes. Tick "apply on top" to continue, or clean it first.
serverview.dlg.blocked: These changes cannot travel, so nothing is moved:
serverview.dlg.bringDone: {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} brought here
serverview.dlg.sendDone: {n, plural, one {# file} other {# files}} sent to the server
serverview.dlg.doneDesc: The changes are uncommitted in the working tree. Nothing was staged or committed.
serverview.blocked.binary: a new binary file is not carried over
serverview.blocked.tooLarge: a new file over 1 MB is not carried over
serverview.blocked.secret: looks like a secret, not carried over
serverview.blocked.symlink: links and submodules are not carried over
serverview.err.originDiffers: The two copies are not the same repository: both need an origin, and it has to name the same repository.
serverview.err.headDiffers: The two copies are on different commits (this Mac {local}, server {server}). Pull or push so both sides are on the same commit, then try again. Nothing is fetched for you.
serverview.err.noCommits: One of the copies has no commit yet. Make the first commit and push it so both sides are on the same commit.
serverview.err.notRepository: The folder on the server is missing or is not a git repository.
serverview.err.runActive: A run on this server is working in that repository. Wait until it has finished, or stop it.
serverview.err.destinationDirty: The destination has uncommitted changes. Choose "apply on top", or clean it first.
serverview.err.applyCheck: The changes do not fit the destination. Nothing was applied.
serverview.err.applyFailed: Git could not apply the changes.
serverview.err.badPatch: The changes touch a link, a submodule, .git or a hooks folder. Nothing was applied.
serverview.err.blocked: Some changes cannot be carried over, so nothing was moved.
serverview.err.tooLarge: The changes are bigger than 20 MB. Commit them and use git instead.
serverview.err.nothingToTransfer: There are no changes to carry over.
serverview.err.readOnly: Read-only mode is on: no connection to a server is made.
serverview.err.testJail: The test jail is on: no connection to a server is made.
serverview.dlg.risky: These files run or configure something on their own, or become executable. Look at them before you carry them over:
serverview.dlg.riskyTick: I have looked at the highlighted files and want them carried over
serverview.dlg.noteContents: The contents of files you have not opened here travel too. A secret inside an ordinarily named file cannot be detected.
serverview.dlg.noteSend: Only runs started from this IDE are detected. A run started from another IDE, or a command running in a terminal on the server, is not.
serverview.err.changedSinceReview: The changes are not the ones you confirmed (something changed meanwhile). Nothing was applied. Look at them again.
serverview.err.riskyPaths: The changes touch files that run or configure something on their own, or become executable. Tick the extra confirmation to carry them over.
serverview.err.localChanged: Your repository changed while you were confirming (another commit, or new uncommitted changes). Nothing was applied. Look at the changes again.
serverview.err.repoBusy: A run is starting in that repository, or another transfer is working there. Try again in a moment.
